_comment: Public texts of the task page and the scorecard (site/build.py). `title` and `subtitle` replace task.json's title; `references` and `baselines` describe each design in one sentence (the internal notes of task.json and tests/expected.json are never shown).
title: Carry-less multiplier
subtitle: Multiply two polynomials over GF(2): ANDs and XORs, no carries.

references.clmul_n: The N × N array: AND partial products summed by rows of XORs, the multiplier's shape without carries.

baselines.school_tree_8: Schoolbook: all N² partial products and a balanced XOR tree per output bit, generated for N = 8 only and checked by simulation.
baselines.school_tree_16: Schoolbook: all N² partial products and a balanced XOR tree per output bit, generated for N = 16 only and checked by simulation.
baselines.school_tree_32: Schoolbook: all N² partial products and a balanced XOR tree per output bit, generated for N = 32 only and checked by simulation.
baselines.kara_b4_8: Karatsuba recursion down to a 4-bit schoolbook base, generated for N = 8 only and checked by simulation.
baselines.kara_b4_16: Karatsuba recursion down to a 4-bit schoolbook base, generated for N = 16 only and checked by simulation: the smallest design on this page.
baselines.kara_b4_32: Karatsuba recursion down to a 4-bit schoolbook base, generated for N = 32 only and checked by simulation.
baselines.kara_b2_16: Karatsuba recursion down to a 2-bit schoolbook base, generated for N = 16 only and checked by simulation.
baselines.kara_b8_16: Karatsuba recursion down to an 8-bit schoolbook base, generated for N = 16 only and checked by simulation.
baselines.kara_full_16: Karatsuba recursion all the way down to single bits, generated for N = 16 only and checked by simulation.
